FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Tax Event Extensibility
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Adds machinery to let submods intercept and redirect tax events.

patchNoteLines.li: Adds ITaxDeliveryInterceptor interface to let submods redirect tax events, or intercept them at time of delivery

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Minor Fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Backend code updates to clean things up a bit.

patchNoteLines.li: Cleans up some code to more properly encapsulate many fields

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: New Scrollbars
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Updates all scrollbars in Empire windows to use flat rectangles instead of the default rounded shape, to be more in line with Empire's general UI design.

patchNoteLines.li: Adds new ScrollUtil class to handle the new scrollbars

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Empire Codex
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Adds the framework for the Empire Codex, meant to be an in-game resource similar to Civilization's Civilopedia.

patchNoteLines.li: Adds framework for the Empire Codex

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Manual Military Updates
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Updates military raids to enable additional military functionality.

patchNoteLines.li: Allows multiple raids to hit the same settlement at once
Allows multiple settlements to be raided at once
Adds backend infrastructure for a submod to implement manual battles for offensive raids

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Codex: Add Resources
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Adds resources to the Empire Codex.

patchNoteLines.li: Adds Resources to the Empire Codex.

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: UI Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Minor backend change to how bonuses are colorized, which should hopefully produce more consistent bonus coloration throughout the UI.

patchNoteLines.li: Change TextUtil.ColorizeAdditiveBonus and ColorizeMultiplierBonus to return strings instead of TaggedStrings

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Backend UI Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Some extensibility changes for the manage units/squads/fire support windows to make it easier for submods to interject their own windows.

patchNoteLines.li: Adds MilitaryWindowRegistry to make it easier for submods to intercept the existing Manage Units/Squads/Fire Support windows and draw their own
